_comment: A REAL raw extraction, captured from the live Intellicar Fleet Overview on
2026-08-02 by scripts/portal-fetch.ts. Not hand-written sample data.
This is the input side of normalizeFleetOverview(): exactly what the
extractor hands over — rendered text, unparsed. It exists so the normalizer,
which is pure, can be exercised and reviewed without a browser, a session or
a network. That is the practical payoff of the extractor/normalizer split.
Note 'No GPS Fix ' carries a trailing space, exactly as the portal renders
it. That is deliberate fidelity, not an editing slip: it is what squash() in
normalizers.ts exists to absorb, and a tidied fixture would stop proving it.
Counts are live values from that moment and are expected to differ from any
later reading. Nothing here is a secret: twelve public status counts.
